title: metadata.endpoints.item's describe() omits the qualified read GET /meta/:type/:ns/:name that the switch also removes (low)
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw6yXcLi9aRRBpPT4W

`RestServerConfig.metadata.endpoints.item` (packages/spec/src/api/rest-server.zod.ts) describes itself as "the whole per-item face — …" and names 13 routes. The mount-table pin `packages/rest/src/rest-config-mount-table.pin.test.ts` (green at 8e3d4a54) shows the switch removes 14: the 13 plus `GET {prefix}/:type/:ns/:name`, the ADR-0150 D5 qualified by-name read (#31691). `metadata.endpoints.maintenance`'s describe() already names all four of its routes.

Fix: add the qualified read to the `item` describe() string and regenerate anything derived from it.

QA-source: #33081 · api-backend.rest-metadata-config-contract · acceptance[2]
